async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to fully load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Search for links containing 'homepage' and 'content' in their text (case-insensitive)
    issue_links = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='homepage').filter(has_text='content')
    count = await issue_links.count()
    if count == 0:
        # If no exact match, try searching for 'homepage' or 'content' separately
        issue_links_homepage = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='homepage')
        count_homepage = await issue_links_homepage.count()
        if count_homepage > 0:
            # Check if any of these links also contain 'content' in a different way
            for i in range(count_homepage):
                link = issue_links_homepage.nth(i)
                text = await link.text_content()
                if 'content' in text.lower():
                    await link.click()
                    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
                    closed_element = page.get_by_text('Closed', exact=True)
                    if await closed_element.count() > 0:
                        return 'The issue is closed.'
                    else:
                        return 'The issue is not closed.'
        return 'No issue found with "homepage content" in title.'
    # Click the first (latest) issue link found
    latest_issue_link = issue_links.first
    await latest_issue_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Check if the issue is closed by looking for 'Closed' text
    closed_element = page.get_by_text('Closed', exact=True)
    if await closed_element.count() > 0:
        return 'The issue is closed.'
    else:
        return 'The issue is not closed.'
